The Gambia Revenue Authority signed an MoU with Sogema Technologies for a new Integrated Tax Administration System to bring e-registration, e-filing and e-payments, funded by the World Bank, as its Commissioner General says.

The Finance Ministry and Gambia Revenue Authority signed a 10-year agreement with InTouch, chosen in an international tender, for a digital platform to monitor transactions and process government payments, with taxpayers paying through several channels; the system is described as to be implemented.

fact: The GRA unveiled ITAS at two stakeholder workshops ahead of nationwide implementation, a platform to automate tax registration, filing and payment across income tax, VAT, customs and excise, with web and mobile e-services.

Deputy Accountant General Ousman Darboe says APS Wallet joins banks and microfinance companies already connected to the GovPay payment gateway used to collect government fees, and the Accountant General says citizens and businesses can pay taxes, fees and levies through it.

Bloom Bank Africa Gambia says it signed an MoU with the Accountant General's Department on 2024-09-30 to support a phased rollout of a digital payment gateway for revenue collection, starting with digitised cash and later bank transfers, online payments, mobile money and POS.
The Gambia Revenue Authority says its new ITAS, being introduced ahead of full rollout, will let taxpayers file returns and make payments online (e-filing, e-payment).

The document says Gambians can now pay taxes, fees and levies electronically through GovPay, the government's digital payment platform, via APS Wallet, per the Accountant General's Department agreement signed 9 April 2026.
